name: Vorkath

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: Vorkath cycles melee, ranged and magic in no fixed order. None of them can be reacted to once launched.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep a protection prayer up the whole fight. Pick the style your gear handles worst.

mechanics.name: Deadly Dragonfire
mechanics.description: A dragonfire ball fired straight up that lands on the tile you are standing on. Neighbouring tiles still take half.
mechanics.counterplay: Step two tiles away as it launches. No dragonfire protection reduces this one.

mechanics.name: Zombified Spawn
mechanics.description: Icy breath freezes you in place and drops a zombified spawn across the arena. It walks at you and detonates on arrival.
mechanics.counterplay: Cast Crumble Undead to delete it instantly. Anything slower and you wear the explosion.

mechanics.name: Venomous Dragonfire
mechanics.description: A green dragonfire breath that venoms you through ordinary dragonfire protection.
mechanics.counterplay: Bring extended anti-venom+, or wear a serpentine helm and forget about it.

mechanics.name: Corrupting Dragonfire
mechanics.description: A white dragonfire breath that switches off every prayer the moment it lands.
mechanics.counterplay: Set quick-prayers and flick them straight back on. Use divine potions, which the drain can't touch.

mechanics.name: Acid Phase
mechanics.description: Vorkath floods the arena with acid pools, then fires dragonfire at your position every tick until the phase ends.
mechanics.counterplay: Walk, never run, along a clear line of at least five tiles. Running spawns fresh acid behind you.

_observed: Trigger ids confirmed against live kills on 2026-08-01. Every projectile below was resolved through gameval SpotanimID rather than guessed: 393 DRAGON_RANGED_FIRE_ATTACK and 1477/1479 (standard rotation), 395 DRAGON_RANGED_ICE_ATTACK (the freeze that precedes the spawn), 1470 DRAGON_RANGED_VENOM_ATTACK, 1471 DRAGON_RANGED_CORRUPTING_ATTACK, 1481/1482 (area dragonfire), 1483 (acid), 1484 (spawn). Animations 7951 and 7957 do fire; an earlier kill missed them only because that fight never went to melee range. Animation 7960 is deadly-dragonfire's wind-up: across two separate fights it fired exactly one second before projectile 1481, so it is now a trigger. Graphics 1466 and 131 are that attack's impact, landing one to two seconds after projectiles 1481 and 1482 respectively in both fights; their gameval names (FIRESURGE_IMPACT, FIREBLAST_IMPACT) are misleading, and they are deliberately NOT triggers because a player casting those spells could produce the same ids. Projectile 146 CRUMBLEUNDEAD_TRAVEL genuinely is the player's, arriving a few seconds after each spawn. Projectile 1482 belongs to acid-phase, not deadly-dragonfire: in both logged fights it fired one to three seconds AFTER the acid phase began, whereas 1481 and its 7960 wind-up fired well before it. It is the rapid dragonfire that chases you across the acid, which is why deadly-dragonfire was announcing during acid phase instead of on the bomb. Projectile 2266 VORKATH_AREA_TRAVEL_SMALL has never been observed in a live fight and is deliberately not a trigger; deadly-dragonfire is already covered by 7960 and 1481. Still unassigned: animation 7950 on engage.

Deliberately omitted: the venomous and prayer-disabling dragonfire variants, which the wiki documents but which have no distinctly named projectile constant. Enable the debug trigger log during a fight to capture their ids, then add them as their own mechanics. See issue #10.
